note: XXV fills: the London opening (11 Oct, sunset, new moon) and Varna days (25–28 Oct) · Booth style
style: An oil painting in colour of 1893 with the drama of Franklin Booth: monumental scale, deep recession, towering forms, strong value contrast and deep shadow, light breaking through haze, a sense of awe. Loose visible brushstrokes, thick impasto in the lights, thin glazes in the shadows, soft lost edges. Cool autumn light, no golden glow except the sun itself at sunset. No moon in any sky. No text, signature or border.

beats.text: Shot: very wide, exterior. A great Victorian asylum among tall old trees at Purfleet on the Thames marshes on 11 October 1893, a little before sunset: long low sun behind bare elms, long shadows across the lawn, a few windows catching the light, no people.

Shot: very wide. The sun, a red disc, touching the flat horizon of the Thames marshes at sunset in October 1893, the wide river shining, sailing barges black against the light, great clouds lit from below, no moon.

Shot: far, exterior, looking in. A tall window of the asylum at dusk seen from the dark garden: inside, a young woman in a dark dress standing very straight before seated men, all small, lit by one lamp, the sky above deep violet with no moon.

Shot: very wide interior from the far dark corner of a book-lined Victorian study at dusk: five men seated and standing very still around a young woman in a dark dress, all small, their faces in shadow, one lamp, the last grey light at the tall windows.

Shot: close, no people. On a dark wooden table in a study at night, a single candle burning in a brass holder, a worn black Bible and a small prayer book beside it, a revolver laid down beside them, deep shadow all around.

Shot: medium-wide interior, no people. A high hotel bedroom in Varna at noon in 1893: white curtains stirring at a tall open window over the bright sea, a bed half hidden behind a screen, a shaft of strong daylight across the floor, the room otherwise in shade.

Shot: very wide. The Black Sea from the town of Varna at sunset in late October 1893: the sun going down into the sea in a band of red, the harbour and its ships in silhouette, a minaret on the shore, great clouds lit from below.

Shot: very wide. A small steam train with a plume of smoke crossing a vast flat autumn plain in Romania toward the Danube in 1893, a line of telegraph poles, a few poplars, towering clouds and a pale sun, the train small.
